title: PGA rampas 65 ekor kambing, lori bernilai RM138,750
summary: Kota Bharu: Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) merampas 65 ekor kambing dipercayai diseludup dari Thailand menerusi Sungai Golok di Pangkalan Haram, dalam operasi di Kampung Kok Bedullah, Tumpat awal pagi tadi.

title_en: PGA seize 65 goats, truck worth RM138,750
summary_en: Kota Bharu: The Gerakan Am (PGA) seized 65 goats suspected of being smuggled from Thailand via the Golok River at Pangkalan Haram, in an operation in Kampung Kok Bedullah, Tumpat early this morning.
